verification: mocked: CI fixture HTTP through the FastAPI test client against fixture SQLite graphs with a fixture semantic source; the cache, key, invalidation and retrieval are the production modules.
assertions: A revoked project grant clears every cached entry on the refused request itself, before another response is served; the regranted project is a fresh miss.
A decision revision written by another connection is served on the next request with its new revision and title; the stale title is absent; an exact replay returns the accepted operation.
A load that began before a decision update is returned to its caller but never stored; the next request misses and reads the new revision.
A restarted process starts with an empty cache and serves the same context for the same knowledge.
Empty or reduced results are marked negative with a two second TTL against thirty seconds for positive results, under a fake clock.
A budget that omits every item serves no items, so it is negative with the two second TTL and expires under the fake clock.
Followers of a failed leader load alone and nothing is stored.
BRAIN_CONTEXT_CACHE=false retrieves per request with state disabled and counts no cache requests.
